occurrences.text: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
